workItem: Evidence provider delivery for Meme/DeFi and added Crypto Orchestrator research features

stackDependency.reason: Evidence adapters bind contracts introduced by PR #485. No PR for this branch is allowed until #485 is merged and this branch is reconciled/rebased against then-current main.

providerDecisions.defillama: existing canonical DeFi TVL/fees/revenue evidence provider; retain ADR-0100 free evidence-only authority
providerDecisions.messari: standardized protocol/on-chain usage evidence where DeFiLlama does not provide the required feature
providerDecisions.dune: governed custom-query fallback for protocol-specific on-chain evidence not standardized by the preceding providers
providerDecisions.newsapi: reuse existing NewsAPI dependency as raw article evidence; X-Api-Key header replaces query-string secret; legacy keyword sentiment remains heuristic only

protectedExistingAuthorities: MarketDataGateway for canonical quote/snapshot routing only
CryptoCategoryFeatureContracts as the single category evidence-definition authority
correlationRules: DeFiLlama remains authoritative for existing free TVL/fees/revenue evidence; Messari must not silently replace those fields.
GoPlus security observations are security evidence, not a score or automatic PASS.
LunarCrush sentiment is external evidence and must remain separable from price/volume confirmations.
CoinGlass derivatives/microstructure evidence must not become an execution price authority.
Dune query IDs and output schemas must be explicitly governed; no arbitrary SQL from user/model input.
NewsAPI articles are raw news evidence; deterministic keyword sentiment remains explicitly heuristic and cannot masquerade as model sentiment.
Missing/stale/unknown provider fields remain NOT_AVAILABLE/STALE/INVALID and never become 0 or PASS.
